authorization: User explicitly requested continued deep optimization after discussing the manuscript's limited contribution. This reopens a bounded scientific adequacy diagnostic, not the former submission-format plan.
question: Are the earlier near-mean predictions specific to representation, function class or regularization range, rather than sufficient evidence that transferable selectivity is unlearnable?
input: Frozen main46 mixed-identity ordinary IC50 pairs only. Retain the existing nine joint source-and-constitution components. No endpoint/identity promotion, new measurement, PAS addition or view selection.
outer_constraint: Leave one existing whole source-and-constitution component out. No same-source or same-constitution overlap across train/test or inner fit/validation.
ridge_objective: mean squared error + lambda*weight_norm_squared, unpenalized intercept; dual penalty n_fit*lambda. Training-only preprocessing. Kernel version centers train/cross kernels with fit statistics and centers fit targets.
molecular_representation: Reuse frozen nonchiral Morgan radius2/2048 on-bits; existing normalization and eight-field metadata blocks. Add exactly ten label-independent descriptors computed from the frozen candidate graph.
descriptor_preprocessing: Ridge: fit-only median/mean/population SD, divide by sqrt10. RF: raw descriptors (finite, deterministic, no label-driven feature selection).
inner_selection: Same leave-one-remaining-component-out inner partitions for every family; minimize equal-inner-group MAE, tolerance1e-12. Ridge ties choose larger lambda. RF ties prefer larger leaf then fewer features. No current outer outcome used to choose any setting.
family_selector: Choose a family/configuration using its inner-CV score only. Candidate order for equal scores: TRAIN_MEAN,TRAIN_MEDIAN,MORGAN_1NN_TIE_MEAN,STRUCTURE_RIDGE_EXPANDED,DESCRIPTOR_RIDGE,JOINT_RIDGE_EXPANDED,TANIMOTO_KRR,DESCRIPTOR_RF. Original-grid replay is a control only. This composite is the pipeline-level comparison; an outer-best family is not declared a validated winner.
outputs: All family predictions/metrics, fold and source metrics, paired differences from same-query training mean, inner loss paths, hyperparameters, nested family choices, effective degrees of freedom or tree complexity, prediction spread, and exact legacy replay.
metrics: Query-weighted MAE, equal-component MAE, equal-paper MAE; count group-level paired improvements, maximum adverse group and response dispersion. Group counts are9 and train sets overlap: do not turn folds or repeated fits into independent replicates or naive p values.
validation: Replay original-grid joint46 predictions, independently replay linear/kernel/forest saved states; check group exclusion, fit-only encoders, nested selection and finite predictions. Finite-kernel eigenvalues checked numerically.
evidence_acquisition: In parallel, at most two targeted searches and one new official supplement/fulltext route for recent released OAT data; failed routes are not repeatedly retried. Any new release remains an unqualified candidate, not automatically an external test.
interpretation: Exploratory model-adequacy diagnostic after many prior analyses, not an untouched final test, new biology, causal assay-bias estimate, calibrated uncertainty or automatic journal upgrade.
stop_rule: Report every model whether favorable or unfavorable; do not extend grids, seeds or data views after seeing this run. Determine next evidence need from this fixed comparison.
old_artifacts: Preserve all existing sealed sources, models, author-confirmed manuscripts and reports. New results stored only in this run. No public release, paid job, journal contact or submission.
